authority.nature: CEILING, not a target; the Director may spend less — including zero — when evidence does not justify spend
authority.allocation: the Director recommends; the Owner does not set allocations manually
never: activate a channel the Owner has not activated (readiness stays Owner-controlled)

assisted_service.pricing: CUSTOM / TO BE DETERMINED AFTER SALE EVALUATION — never published, never a fixed price in any creative, landing page, form or ad; the Director may use AVAILABILITY as strategic intelligence only
copy_allowed: Hands-on help available in Houston and the NYC area
Prefer us to run the sale? Ask about assisted service

proposal_shape: SUCCESS_SIGNAL (first-party outcome, not a platform metric)
proposal_rules: every proposal names the first-party success signal (registration, draft, publish, watch, bid, purchase, seller inquiry) and the platform proxy it will be judged against until the signal matures
every proposal names the measurement it depends on; a proposal whose measurement is MISSING or PARTIAL in the readiness audit cannot be activated
budget per campaign window ≤ 40% of the monthly ceiling unless a WINNER state justifies more
at least 10% of any active month is reserved for experiments unless total spend is under $200
retargeting and suppression audiences require consent-compliant first-party data; otherwise the campaign runs without them and says so

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.action: continue to the next checkpoint unless the spend pace exceeds the window cap

EARLY_SIGNAL.definition: ≥ 30 sessions with an engaged-session rate or a proxy conversion rate outside the pooled baseline by a wide margin (≥ 2× or ≤ 0.5×) but not yet significant
EARLY_SIGNAL.action: note; may shift ≤ 20% of window budget toward or away; no scaling decisions

MEANINGFUL_SIGNAL.definition: ≥ 100 sessions or ≥ 10 first-party conversions and a difference from the pooled baseline with p < 0.10 (two-proportion test) or a Bayesian probability ≥ 80%
MEANINGFUL_SIGNAL.action: shift budget up to 50%; test alternatives against it

WINNER.definition: MEANINGFUL_SIGNAL held across two consecutive checkpoints with cost per first-party outcome at or below the objective's target and no subscriber-health or safety flag
WINNER.action: scale within window cap; raise the cap with a reasoned proposal

LOSER.definition: ≥ 100 sessions or ≥ $150 spend with cost per outcome > 2× target and no EARLY_SIGNAL of improvement, or any policy/safety/quality flag

checkpoints.rule: evaluate continuously at spend/impression/click/conversion thresholds, never on a calendar alone
thresholds: 72h after any state change (re-check for regression)
anti_overreaction: no LOSER call before 100 sessions or $150 unless a safety/policy flag
no WINNER call without two checkpoints
platform-reported conversions are provisional until reconciled to first-party outcomes

bounded_actions: SHIFT_BUDGET (within the month's ceiling and window caps)

owner_report.cadence: weekly digest + on any state change; monthly summary
per_material_campaign: WHAT HAPPENED AFTER THE CLICK (sessions → engaged → registrations → intent → marketplace actions → outcomes)
WHAT THE DIRECTOR IS DOING NEXT (increase / decrease / stop / continue / reallocate, with the reason)
never_shown: channel media costs attributed to package fulfilment
owner_report.tone: plain sentences; numbers with their confidence state; no dashboards required to understand it
